summary: Prudential plc furnished a routine Form 6-K containing UK Market Abuse Regulation notifications of dealings by persons discharging managerial responsibilities. CFO Ben Bulmer, CHRO Catherine Chia, Chief Risk and Compliance Officer Avnish Kalra, and Rajeev Mittal of Eastspring Investments each acquired ordinary shares of 5 pence at GBP 9.024248 per share on 2026-10-12 via the Prudential All Employee Share Purchase Plan, on the London Stock Exchange. Volumes were 46, 42, 46 and 46 shares respectively. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms apply; this is an ordinary employee-plan share purchase disclosure, not a special situation.
